text.short: Delay starts to sharpen the road's danger.
text.summary: A second time beat after the urgency report records that conditions are worsening even before the final resolution.
text.full: By the time a second pause settles over the investigation, the pattern around the road has shifted from troubling to worsening. Rain, fear, and rumor begin erasing the easy pieces first.
text.recap: Another time beat worsened conditions around the Grey Road.
